# Copilot Instructions

All agent rules for this repository live in [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md).

This file intentionally contains no rules of its own. It exists only so that
GitHub Copilot discovers the vendor-neutral contract. Do not add
model-specific instructions here — if a rule is worth having, it belongs in
`AGENTS.md` where every agent and every human can read it.

Start with `AGENTS.md` §1 (non-negotiable rules) before making any change.
